items.text:
**Tooling GO.** PySDD 1.0.6 supports local moves on a live compiled SDD without recompiling the CNF.

The supported method keeps roots referenced, garbage-collects before moving, and uses the manager-owned vtree:

- Swap: `v.swap(manager, 0)`
- Left rotation: `v.right().rotate_left(manager, 0)`
- Right rotation: `v.rotate_right(manager, 0)`

Reacquire tree pointers after moves; undo rejected candidates and replay the winner. This matches the [official rotation example](https://pysdd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/build_formula.html#example-4-vtree-rotations).

The prototype passed **1,718 moves and their inverses**, exhaustive function checks, factor checks, and limited-failure rollback tests. Across eight synthetic cases, complete search rounds were **2.0–10.6× faster** than fresh compilation with preloaded vtrees.

[Full report and measurements](<C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/Structured Factorization/live_vtree_probe_2026-09-29/REPORT.md>) · [Prototype](<C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/Structured Factorization/live_vtree_probe_2026-09-29/live_moves.py>)

All **3,821 protected files remained unchanged**. No campaign was rerun or retuned; no semantic prime truth entered objectives.

Nothing remains required. Defer campaign integration until separately authorized; no further task or model run is needed now.
